source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 mai — «Sfântul Cuvios Pahomie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Μαΐου — «Όσιοι Μάμας, Παχώμιος και Ιλαρίων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and the rank matches: doxologia's «Sfântul Cuvios Pahomie» against saint.gr's Όσιος, with the same two companions. **The Greek is the first source to say anything about him** — the desert place, the fasting and vigils and good works, the concord of soul, the falling asleep in peace, and the synaxis «εν Οχείαις» — and its couplet names all three together. **He is not Pachomius the Great**, the father of the cenobitic life kept on 15 May, whose account nothing here touches; this one is one of three monks on 6 May with no country and no century. **The third of the trio, Ιλαρίων, becomes a new folder `hilarion-6-may`** rather than a row on `hilarion-4-may`; the reasoning is on that folder. No year, no place, no hymn.
